auditFindings.title: Audit Findings
auditFindings.subtitle: Record, track, and manage audit findings and recommendations
auditFindings.1WhyDoesTheErrorOccur:
1. Why does the error occur? Credit officers do not conduct actual appraisals of collateral assets.
2. Why don't officers go for appraisal? Because the pressure to complete the loan balance growth target at the end of the quarter is very high.
3. Why does quota pressure lead to process abandonment? Because the current process allows officers to take responsibility without being required to upload actual GPS positioning images.
4. Why no GPS? The loan origination system has not yet integrated automatic field positioning.
5. Why not integrated? There is no requirement for automatic cross-control operations from the Risk Management Division.
auditFindings.1WhyIsTheSystemInterrupted:
1. Why is the system interrupted? Because the Core Banking database is suspended.
2. Why does the database hang? Because the number of concurrent queries exceeds the load limit of the main server.
3. Why doesn't the secondary server automatically take on the load? Due to the automatic failover configuration, real-time data synchronization fails.
4. Why does the failover configuration fail to synchronize? Because the backup bandwidth between the two data centers is choked.
5. Why is bandwidth blocked without prior detection? Lack of monitoring and early warning system for WAN connection bandwidth capacity.
auditFindings.1WhyDoesTheErrorArise:
1. Why does the error arise? Officers incorrectly follow professional instructions.
2. Why did officials do it wrong? Because the operational instructions are too complicated and have not been updated according to new regulations.
3. Why not updated? Lack of focal personnel responsible for reviewing the internal document system.
4. Why is there a lack of specialized focal points? Because the departmental organizational structure has not clearly defined this function.
5. Why is it not clearly defined? Because risk appetite and process management framework have not been standardized at the Block level.
auditFindings.1RequestTheBranchToImmediately: 1. Request the branch to immediately correct the actual appraisal work and re-evaluate all collateral assets of the loan.\n2. Issue a document reviewing personal responsibilities of credit officers and grant related approvals.\n3. Propose that the Technology Division integrates a mandatory GPS field check-in feature on the loan origination application to prevent false documents.
auditFindings.1UpgradeCoreBankingServerCapacity: 1. Upgrade Core Banking server capacity and expand connection bandwidth between the main and backup data centers.\n2. Configure and retest the automatic failover mechanism between DC and DR on a monthly basis.\n3. Issuing system load control procedures (Load Testing) before deploying upgraded versions or major promotional campaigns.
auditFindings.thereIsARiskOfAsset: There is a risk of asset loss, bad debt arising, and financial loss for the bank due to false or unrealistic valuation of collateral assets; At the same time, seriously violating LPBank's credit granting regulations and Clause 2, Article 14 of Circular 13/2018/TT-NHNN, the SBV inspection and supervision agency may handle administrative violations.
auditFindings.1UrgentlyReviewSimplifyAndUpdate: 1. Urgently review, simplify and update detailed professional guidance for implementing staff.\n2. Organize retraining on standard procedures for all relevant personnel.\n3. Establish a weekly checking and comparison mechanism between the Operations department and the Control department to detect discrepancies early.
auditFindings.coreBankingHardwareEquipmentIsSuddenly: Core Banking hardware equipment is suddenly overloaded due to high transaction volume during peak hours, while the backup system (DRS) has not automatically activated failover in time. Disaster recovery drill procedures have not been performed periodically to detect network congestion.
auditFindings.disruptionOfOnlinePaymentServicesCausing: Disruption of online payment services, causing frustration for customers, reducing LPBank's brand reputation; potential risk of compensating financial losses to partners and violating regulations on ensuring continuity of operations in Clause 1, Article 23 of Circular 13/2018/TT-NHNN.
auditFindings.creditOfficersChaseBusinessTargetsAnd: Credit officers chase business targets and subjectively ignore actual asset inspection processes. The unit's leadership has not closely monitored appraisal activities and lacks automatic cross-check points on the loan origination system.
auditFindings.potentialRiskOfAssetLossAnd: Potential risk of asset loss and accumulated violations over many periods of time if timely corrective action is not taken; Failure to strictly comply with internal control regulations and standard business processes of LPBank.
auditFindings.operationalStaffsComplianceWithProcedure: Operational staff's compliance with procedures is not high; lack of regular cross-checking and comparison mechanisms between departments; Self-inspection (Line 1) at the unit is still formal and does not go deeply into the nature of risks.

dynamicRerating.linkageAlertDesc: The system automatically synchronizes continuous risk monitoring results (Line 1 & Line 2) to calculate the dynamic risk score. For entities whose risk status changes to HIGH or CRITICAL, the audit plan will automatically adjust the annual schedule (nextAuditYear), shortening the cycle to an emergency audit in the current year.

standards.1Li2: Automated Risk Map: Reflects Line 2 KRI fluctuations instantly into the matrix.
standards.1Li3: Independent Monitoring: Ensures reliability and objectivity of internal controls.
standards.2Li1: Audit Frequency Rules: Weak (Level 4) and Poor (Level 5) risk processes must be audited at least once a year.
standards.2Li2: Fluctuation Index Review: Continuously update Annual Audit Plan when serious violations are detected.
